column1: # Figures of the compact line of the performance statistics, with the message that wasm/wasmplayer.cpp then sends to the
# front end and the line the front end shows for it. Both sides read this file: FormatCompactStatsMessage() in
# wasm/compact_stats.hpp (tests/native/compact_stats_test.cpp) writes the message, and formatCompactStatsLine() in
# wasm/platform/messages.js (tests/unit/compact-stats.test.js) builds the line from it, so the two stay the same.
# Format, separated by tabs: width, height, frame rate, codec, bit depth, HDR (1 or 0), rendered frame rate, bitrate in
# Mbps, RTT in ms (0 while unknown), network drops in percent, wait plus pacing in ms (a negative figure is unknown), the
# message, the line (in English, with the separator ' · ').
